name: UNIV 4610
title: Showcasing your Competencies: Crafting Pre-Health Applications
description: Seminar on the reflective and practical aspects of preparing for health professions applications. Key issues in the pre-health journey, emphasizing the articulation of values, motivations, strengths, and experiences.
requirement_description: Instructor consent required. Students who have passed UNIV 4611 may earn only one credit for UNIV 4610. Not open for credit to students who have passed UNIV 4612 or UNIV 3995 offered as "Showcasing your Competencies: Crafting Pre-Health Applications.”
